summary: blockinfile inserts, updates or removes a multi-line block between marker lines. Use a unique marker per block, especially in loops, since otherwise blocks overwrite each other.
questions: How do I manage a multi-line section of a config file with Ansible?
Why does my blockinfile loop keep overwriting the same block?
How do I manage two separate blocks in one file?
Is dest or path the right option for blockinfile?

answer_card.title: Manage text blocks with blockinfile
answer_card.answer_md:
`ansible.builtin.blockinfile` manages a block of text surrounded by marker lines.

- With loops or multiple blocks in one file, set a **unique `marker`** per block or each run overwrites the last.
- `path` is the main option since 2.3 (`dest` still works).
